abilities.name: lightning-rod
abilities.effect: Redirects single-target electric moves to this Pokémon where possible.  Absorbs Electric moves, raising Special Attack one stage.

abilities.name: reckless
abilities.effect: Strengthens recoil moves to 1.2× their power.

kanto.flavorText: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

original-johto.flavorText: By lightly spin­ ning its drill- like horn, it can easily shatter even a diamond in the rough.

hoenn.flavorText: Its horn, which rotates like a drill, destroys tall buildings with one strike. It stands on its hind legs, and its brain is well developed.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: Its brain developed after it stood up on its hind legs. Its drill horn bores tunnels through solid rock.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: Standing on its hind legs freed its forelegs and made it smarter. It is very forgetful, however.

updated-johto.flavorText: Its brain developed when it began walking on hind legs. Its thick hide protects it even in magma.

original-unova.flavorText: Standing on its hind legs freed its forelegs and made it smarter. It is very forgetful, however.

updated-unova.flavorText: Standing on its hind legs freed its forelegs and made it smarter. It is very forgetful, however.

kalos.flavorText: It begins walking on its hind legs after evolution. It can punch holes through boulders with its horn.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Rhydon has a horn that serves as a drill. It is used for destroying rocks and boulders. This Pokémon occasionally rams into streams of magma, but the armor-like hide prevents it from feeling the heat.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: Its brain developed when it began walking on its hind legs. Its armor-like hide even repels molten lava.

swsh.flavorText: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

pla.flavorText: Rapidly rotates its horn to bore through bedrock. It swaggers around volcanic regions, protected from the lava's heat by its tough, armorlike hide.
